v1.0.1-preview.8
- Made FirebaseCoreException generic over the error-code type (FirebaseCoreException<TErrorCode>), eliminating MapToCoreCode round-trip mapping and reverse-mapping hazards.
- Deleted CoreErrorCode.LocalCacheFull (Firestore concept that leaked into Core); service-specific codes now live entirely in their owning packages.
- CoreErrorCode returns to being a pure Core/transport vocabulary.

v1.0.0-preview5
- Synchronized package version with the Firestore browser-WASM startup fix.
- Validated the SDK-owned default HTTP transport with browser platform HttpClient on browser and SocketsHttpHandler off-browser.

v1.0.0-preview4
- Improved browser-WASM startup compatibility by isolating default HTTP transport initialization.

v1.0.0-preview3
- Default HTTP transport is now SDK-owned instead of host HttpClientFactory-created.
- Off-browser transport uses a lazy shared HttpClient backed by SocketsHttpHandler with pooled connection lifetime and cookies disabled.
- Fixed browser-WASM startup when DI resolves the default HTTP transport before any Firebase request is sent.

v1.0.0-preview2
- Initial v1.0.0-preview2 package.
